units: <cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 27b">R. Hash. 27ᵇ</cite>, a. e. (ref. to <he>והעברת</he>, <cite ref="Leviticus 25:9">Lev. XXV, 9</cite>) <he>דרך הַעֲבָרָתוֹ</he> (leave the horn) in the way in which it was borne by the living animal (in its natural shape).

senses.gloss: (= הַעֲבָרַת קול) causing the sound to pass over a certain space, proclamation. Ib. 34ᵃ דיליף ה׳ ה׳ ממשה Ms. M. (ed. דגמר עברה ע׳) we learn the meaning of העביר (Lev. l. c.) from the meaning it has in reference to Moses (Ex. XXXVI, 6).
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 96b:2">Sabb. 96ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 413:2">Yalk. Ex. 413</cite>.

senses.gloss: leading across, passing; in gen. use of the stem עבר.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 7:10:2">Y. Snh. VII, 25ᵇ</cite> bot. (interch. with <he>עברה</he>); Sifra K’doshim ch. VIII, Par. 4 <he>מה ה׳ וכ׳</he> as the ‘passing’ there (<cite ref="Deuteronomy 18:10">Deut. XVIII, 10</cite>) means through fire, so does the ‘passing’ here (<cite ref="Leviticus 18:21">Lev. XVIII, 21</cite>).

<cite ref="Bekhorot 32a:22">Bekh. 32ᵃ</cite> <he>ה׳ ה׳ ממעשר</he> analogy between the first-born and the tithes founded on the use of the stem <cite ref="P00061"><he>עבר</he></cite> (<cite ref="Exodus 13:12">Ex. XIII, 12</cite>, a.

senses.gloss: (from Num. VIII, 7; VI, 5, a. e.) הַעֲבָרַת שיער passing the razor over the hair, shaving.
units: <cite ref="Nazir 58b">Naz. 58ᵇ</cite>, sq. <he>ה׳ ש׳</he> removing the hair of the body. Y. ib. II, end, 52ᵇ <he>לה׳ ש׳</he> for the purpose of removing the hair, opp. <he>גידול שיער</he>.
